stem:
A model is shaded to represent an expression.

Create an equation that represents the expression and its product.

Move the correct answer to each box. Not all answers will be used.
visual_elements:
Two rectangle models shown side by side; each rectangle divided into 8 parts with 6 parts shaded.
A key shows a full rectangle with all 8 parts shaded equals 1.
notes: The problem is drag and drop with numbers 2, 3, 5, 6, 10 to fill in blanks in an equation involving shaded parts of 8.
